description_summary: Investigate bugs and errors in TypeScript starter — root-cause analysis for crashes, exceptions, stack traces, test failures. Use --parallel for deep 4-track investigation.
should_trigger: Diagnose this reproducible Fastify error before changing any code.
Find the root cause of the stale mobile screen after reconnect.
Reproduce this failing TypeScript behavior and test a hypothesis.
Investigate why the web client sometimes drops session updates.
Debug the first error from this failed workspace build.
should_trigger_test: Separate the trigger from downstream symptoms in this worker crash.
Use independent investigations to narrow a bug crossing several package boundaries.
should_not_trigger: Create an implementation plan for a feature spanning API, database and clients.
Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Walk me through how this TypeScript starter plugin is organized.
